About Dr. Usman

Where Artistry
Meets Precision

Dr. Usman Liaqat is a board-certified Plastic & Reconstructive Surgeon with 9+ years of excellence at Dr. Khalid Alruhaimi Hospital & Complexes in Dammam and Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia.

He combines evidence-based surgical precision with a refined aesthetic eye — delivering natural, lasting transformations tailored to each patient's individual beauty goals.
